title: 顾客反馈太少，怎样验证新的收集方式？
topic: 试点数字反馈渠道并验证顾客体验

source.title: Elevating Customer Experiences: McDonald's Piloting a New Digital Feedback Platform
source.section: Elevating Customer Experiences: McDonald's Piloting a New Digital Feedback Platform
source.type: 麦当劳官方业务案例：顾客反馈平台试点
source.context: 麦当劳 麦当劳官方业务案例：顾客反馈平台试点。
paragraphs: McDonald’s is testing a new digital feedback platform, making it simpler and faster for customers to share their thoughts after a visit in a limited number of U.S. and Australian restaurants. Designed to replace the traditional paper-based process, the new system offers a more accessible and streamlined way for people to communicate their feedback.

Typically, guests have to manually enter a long URL from their paper receipts into a browser after visiting the restaurant. This new system will eliminate that hassle by offering a more seamless and user-friendly experience.

The digital feedback tool will seamlessly integrate into McDonald's existing mobile app. About an hour after an order is placed in the app, a notification prompts feedback, from food quality to service efficiency. The team behind this model aimed to move away from only asking “Yes” and “No” questions and toward prompts that gleaned deeper insights into the restaurant experience.

Once submitted, responses will be analyzed using data tools that sort insights by relevance and urgency. This will make it easier for our teams to spot trends, act quickly, and make meaningful improvements. With our new platform, roughly 20 responses are now collected for every 1,000 guests. That’s a major leap from before, when only 1 in every 1,000 people were expected to respond.

For guests, the refreshed experience will offer a convenient and efficient way to collaborate with McDonald’s and maintain strong, positive connections. For McDonald's, it provides valuable insights into people’s preferences and potential areas of improvement. By implementing changes based on real-time feedback, we can enhance our overall restaurant experience.
translations: 麦当劳正在美国和澳大利亚的少数餐厅试用新的数字反馈平台，让顾客在用餐后更简单、更快地分享意见。新系统将取代纸质流程，让顾客更方便地反馈。
过去，顾客离店后通常需要手动把纸质收据上的长网址输入浏览器。新系统将免去这一步，让反馈流程更顺畅、易用。
数字反馈工具会整合进麦当劳现有的手机应用。顾客在应用下单约一小时后，会收到一条邀请反馈的通知，内容涵盖食品质量和服务效率。团队希望减少只问“是”或“否”的问题，改为收集更深入的餐厅体验信息。
提交的回应会通过数据工具分析，并按相关程度和紧急程度分类，帮助团队更快发现趋势、采取行动并作出改进。新平台每 1,000 位顾客大约能收集到 20 条反馈；此前预计每 1,000 人只有 1 人回应。
对顾客来说，更新后的体验提供了更方便、高效的反馈方式，有助于维持良好的联系。对麦当劳来说，这个平台提供了顾客偏好和改进机会的信息。根据实时反馈作出调整，可以改善整体餐厅体验。
fullTextParagraphs: McDonald’s is testing a new digital feedback platform, making it simpler and faster for customers to share their thoughts after a visit in a limited number of U.S. and Australian restaurants. Designed to replace the traditional paper-based process, the new system offers a more accessible and streamlined way for people to communicate their feedback.

Typically, guests have to manually enter a long URL from their paper receipts into a browser after visiting the restaurant. This new system will eliminate that hassle by offering a more seamless and user-friendly experience.
The fresh approach will leverage advanced technology to collect, analyze, and implement customer feedback in real-time, ensuring that McDonald's can respond swiftly to guest needs and preferences.

The digital feedback tool will seamlessly integrate into McDonald's existing mobile app. About an hour after an order is placed in the app, a notification prompts feedback, from food quality to service efficiency. The team behind this model aimed to move away from only asking “Yes” and “No” questions and toward prompts that gleaned deeper insights into the restaurant experience.

Once submitted, responses will be analyzed using data tools that sort insights by relevance and urgency. This will make it easier for our teams to spot trends, act quickly, and make meaningful improvements. With our new platform, roughly 20 responses are now collected for every 1,000 guests. That’s a major leap from before, when only 1 in every 1,000 people were expected to respond.

For guests, the refreshed experience will offer a convenient and efficient way to collaborate with McDonald’s and maintain strong, positive connections. For McDonald's, it provides valuable insights into people’s preferences and potential areas of improvement. By implementing changes based on real-time feedback, we can enhance our overall restaurant experience.

Technology plays a key role in helping McDonald’s stay responsive to evolving guest needs and better achieve our goals––to feed and foster our communities. Through the new digital feedback platform, it will be easier than ever for people to share what’s on their minds. By offering a more accessible and efficient way to share responses, McDonald's is not only enhancing its customer experience but is also paving the way for future innovations.

scenario.title: 模拟门店试点：让顾客更方便地提交反馈
english: A store receives very few comments through its paper receipt survey.
The team wants to test a short in-app prompt in three locations for one month.
You need to explain the customer benefit and the metric you will review.
chinese: 门店通过纸质收据问卷收到的意见很少。
团队想在三家门店试用一个月的应用内简短反馈入口。
你需要说明对顾客的好处，以及试点后要复盘的指标。

firstAttempt.prompt: 请用英语向门店团队提出一次数字反馈试点：说明纸质流程的不便、顾客能得到什么，以及你们会怎样比较结果后决定是否扩大。
firstAttempt.sample: Guests have to type a long URL from the receipt after a visit. We’re testing a short in-app feedback prompt in three stores for a month. This makes it easier for customers to share their thoughts. We’ll compare response rates before deciding whether to expand the pilot.
firstAttempt.rationale: 先说清旧流程和顾客获得的便利，再提出试点范围与评估指标。

taskPhrases.collocation: test something in a small number of locations
taskPhrases.example: We’re testing a short in-app feedback prompt in three stores.
taskPhrases.translation: 我们正在三家门店试用一个简短的应用内反馈入口。

taskPhrases.word: This makes it easier for customers to…
taskPhrases.collocation: make it easier for someone to + verb
taskPhrases.example: This makes it easier for customers to share feedback after a visit.
taskPhrases.translation: 这样顾客用餐后就更容易分享反馈。

taskPhrases.example: We’ll compare response rates before deciding whether to expand the pilot.
taskPhrases.translation: 我们会先比较回应率，再决定是否扩大试点。

words.example: The in-app prompt increased the feedback response rate.
words.translation: 应用内提示提高了反馈回应率。
words.note: 表示收到回应的人数占邀请人数的比例。

words.example: The new process gives customers a more streamlined way to respond.
words.translation: 新流程让顾客可以更顺畅地提交反馈。
words.note: 常形容流程步骤更少、操作更方便。

words.example: The comments gave the team useful customer insight.
words.translation: 这些意见让团队更了解顾客的想法。

rewrite.good: Customers currently have to type a long URL from their receipt. Could we test a short in-app prompt in three stores for a month? It would make feedback easier to share. Before expanding, we’ll compare response rates with the paper survey.
rewrite.translation: 顾客目前需要在离店后手动输入收据上的长网址。我们能否先在三家门店试用一个月的应用内短问卷？这样顾客更容易提交反馈。决定扩大范围前，我们会把回应率与纸质问卷作比较。
rewrite.pattern: Customers currently have to [friction]. Could we test [change] in [scope]? It would make it easier for them to [benefit]. We’ll compare [metric] before deciding whether to expand.

choice.prompt: 纸质问卷回应很少，门店想知道应用内反馈入口是否值得扩大。应当怎么做？
options: Replace every survey immediately and assume customers will respond more.
Test the prompt in a few locations, compare response rates, and review the quality of feedback.
Add more yes-or-no questions to the paper receipt.
choice.why: 小范围测试并比较数据，才能判断顾客是否更愿意反馈。

output.prompt: 客户服务中心想把电话满意度调查改成短信链接。请说明现有流程给客户带来的不便、试点范围，以及要比较的指标。
output.sample: Customers have to stay on the phone to complete the survey, which can make it inconvenient. We’re testing a text-message link with two support teams for three weeks. We’ll compare completion rates and the detail in customer comments before deciding whether to expand it.
check: 说明旧流程的顾客不便
